cause: The Docker package gate selected llm_cache_reference, which requires Python source files outside the image. Earlier validation configured a real reference checkout and missed this packaging precondition. The ROCm speculative source check had the same external-checkout requirement.
fix: Keep strict source checks for development and use explicit --fixtures package tests.
Run all recorded cases and managed checks in package mode; reject missing fixtures and incorrect expected values.
Use the HIP fixture driver for HIP builds and isolate inherited GPU masks.
